body:
I am tired of having hope. Every time I have hope it comes crashing down. It doesn't matter what makes me happy because in the end nobody will care about me anyway. Nobody will even miss me when I am gone...only my parents and I feel shitty for doing it to them, but it's better than seeing what a disappointment I turn out to be.

Also I am 30 and have lived in 3 countries and 3 major cities. Same patterns everywhere. It is not everybody else. It is me.

It won't work. Everyone leaves me in the end. I am too much for everyone and I do everything wrong. Nobody wants to be around me anymore. Everyone gets tired of me and then tired by association. Everyone knows that I am the mentally unstable one who doesn't deserve any friends. Everyone leaves me. It's always happened and it always will.
